content: Publish OS resource usage Type: valid Description: For every function (main, API, ISR) it SHALL be possible to describe the OS resources used within the function. Rationale: To configure the OS correctly the access to OS resources has to be specified for every function. The BSW Scheduler must be able to resolve the task context in which any OS resource may be used. Dependencies: [RS_BSWMD_00030], [RS_BSWMD_00047] Use Case: Configure the OS with the right OS resource accesses. Supporting Material: 
